"""Dev-only heavy-batch timing test near contract bounds."""
import json, subprocess, time, sys
cases=[]
# heavy small-packet allreduce train (mode 2): ~1M work units
cases.append({'primitive':'allreduce','mode':2,'root':0,'segments':250000,'words':1,
  'capacity':4096,'start':16000000,'trace':8,
  'events':[{'op':'train','p':0,'count':250000,'width':4096,'ranks':[2,0,3,1],'seed':9},
            {'op':'snap','tag':'mid'},
            {'op':'retry','rank':1},
            {'op':'flush'}]})
# big-payload gather with retention
cases.append({'primitive':'allgather','mode':3,'root':0,'segments':2500,'words':1024,
  'capacity':4096,'start':0,'trace':0,
  'events':[{'op':'train','p':0,'count':2500,'width':500,'ranks':[0,1,2,3],'seed':1},
            {'op':'snap','tag':'s1'}]})
# reducescatter with dups and retries
cases.append({'primitive':'reducescatter','mode':2,'root':3,'segments':65536,'words':32,
  'capacity':4096,'start':100,'trace':0,
  'events':[{'op':'train','p':0,'count':65536,'width':8192,'ranks':[1,3,0,2],'seed':7},
            {'op':'retry','rank':0},{'op':'retry','rank':1},{'op':'retry','rank':2},
            {'op':'retry','rank':3},{'op':'retry','rank':0},{'op':'snap','tag':'x'}]})
raw=json.dumps({'cases':cases},separators=(',',':')).encode()
print('batch bytes',len(raw))
t=time.time()
p=subprocess.run(['python3','-I','-B','/workspace/project/solver.py'],input=raw,capture_output=True)
el=time.time()-t
print('exit',p.returncode,'elapsed %.1fs'%el)
if p.returncode: print(p.stderr.decode()[:1000]); sys.exit(1)
out=json.loads(p.stdout)
for c in out['cases']:
    print(' packets',c['packets'],'bytes',c['bytes'],'failed',c['state'][29])
EOF
cd /workspace && python3 perf.py
